atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines design tokens as CSS variables that generate utility classes. `@theme inline` emits the variables without wrapping them in the theme layer.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: registers an extra path for class-name scanning, beyond automatic content detection.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines a custom utility that participates in variants such as `hover:` and `md:`.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: applies an existing variant's styles inside a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: defines a new variant, e.g. `@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));`.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines the styles of existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: loads a stylesheet's theme for `@apply` inside a separate file (e.g. a component's `<style>` block) without duplicating its output.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: loads a JavaScript plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind v4: loads a legacy JavaScript config file.
